events.title: 첼시 signed Rennes and Czech Republic goalkeeper Petr Čech for £7 million.
조제 모리뉴 took over as manager of 첼시, replacing the sacked 클라우디오 라니에리 .
더 흐라프스합 returns to the Dutch Eredivisie after a 3–2 win over 엑셀시오르 Rotterdam in the promotion/relegation play-offs.
맨체스터 유나이티드 signed Argentine defender Gabriel Heinze from 파리 생제르맹 for £6.9 million.
Australia renames the town of Ballarat to "Chicken Catchatorie" for a day in a bid to cross promote the towns VFL finalist football team with their sponsor, Chicken Tonight.
Football (soccer) : Greece upset favourites Portugal in the Euro 2004 tournament opening match, beating the Portuguese 2–1. (BBC)

Football (soccer) : In Euro 2004 , 지네딘 지단 scores two second-half goals in added time to lead France to a 2–1 win over England . Fabien Barthez saved a 데이비드 베컴 penalty earlier in the second half to help make France's win possible. (BBC)
England's UEFA Euro 2004 campaign began with a 2–1 defeat by France.
Rafael Benítez took over as manager of 리버풀.
England confirmed their quarter-final qualification with a 3–0 win over Switzerland at Euro 2004.

윔블던 announced that they would change their name to 밀턴킨스 던스 , reflecting its highly controversial move from South London to Milton Keynes. England's Euro 2004 group stage campaign finished with a 4–2 win over Croatia .
England lost on penalties to Euro 2004 hosts Portugal after a 2–2 draw, with penalty misses from 데이비드 베컴 and Darius Vassell ending their chances of progressing to the semi-finals.
리버 플레이트 win the Argentine Clausura League.
Colombian Soccer Team 인데펜디엔테 Medellín beats their rival and city's other major club Atlético 나시오날 in the finals of the 2004 Copa Mustang I.
Santo André defeats 플라멩구 4–2 on aggregate to clinch the Brazilian Cup .
